heading.title: Of the Communication, Acceptance and Revocation of Proposals

article.title: Acceptance by performing conditions, or receiving consideration.
article.content: Performance of the conditions of a proposal, or the acceptance of any consideration for a reciprocal promise which may be offered with a proposal, is an acceptance of the proposal.
article.html:
8Acceptance by performing conditions, or receiving consideration.

Section 8 · Chapter I · page 12 of the Act

Performance of the conditions of a proposal, or the acceptance of any consideration for a reciprocal promise which may be offered with a proposal, is an acceptance of the proposal.
